note: Free or public programs. Links are checked by the monthly job; a broken link is flagged in the page footer.

items.name: USPTO Patent Pro Bono Program
items.what: Free patent legal help for inventors and small businesses with limited income, matched through regional programs.

items.name: USPTO law school clinics and legal help
items.what: Law students at 60+ schools help eligible inventors prepare and file patent and trademark applications at no cost.

items.name: USPTO free resources for inventors
items.what: Path to a Patent webinars, boot camps, and Patent and Trademark Resource Centers in 80+ libraries.

items.name: SBA local assistance
items.what: Find your nearest Small Business Development Center, SCORE mentor or Women’s Business Center.

items.name: Small Business Development Centers
items.what: Free one-on-one advising and low-cost training, hosted by universities and state agencies.

items.name: MBDA Business Centers
items.what: Federal minority-business centers. Their status has been in court since 2025 cuts; as of Feb 2026 a court order had reversed some of them (GAO).

items.name: FDIC list of Minority Depository Institutions
items.what: Every federally insured Black-owned and other minority-owned bank, by state.
